errors.text_span: което визуално подчертава нарастването на оценката за уязвимост с повишаване на образователния статус
errors.evidence: The description makes an interpretive claim that the chart shows an increase in vulnerability assessment with an increase in educational status. This is an inference about the relationship between the two variables, not something explicitly stated. Moreover, the trend is not perfectly monotonic, as 'Работници без образование' (Workers without education) has a higher value (1,312) than 'Работници с начално образование' (Workers with primary education) (1,271).

errors.text_span: етикетите на стълбовете са ясно изписани и съдържат както описанието на категорията, така и точната стойност, която се измерва
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar labels contain both the category description and the exact value. In the chart, the category descriptions are on the vertical axis to the left of the bars, while the numerical values are separate labels to the right of the bars.
